title: Boston-Area Inflation Was 3.7% in July 2026; Energy Prices Rose 16%
description:
Boston inflation reached 3.7% year over year in July 2026, with energy prices rising 16%. This Boston economic news explainer starts with that energy squeeze, explains what an annual inflation rate means for your budget, and separates the regional average from your own bills. Next come food inflation at 3.1%, core inflation at 3.0%, listed-rent growth at 2.6%, and August unemployment at 4.3%, not seasonally adjusted. My take: these figures call for a closer look at essential expenses, not a claim that every household faces the same squeeze. Four audience questions make room for your experience before a practical budget takeaway.

For entertainment and informational purposes only. This is not financial, legal, medical, or other professional advice. Consult a qualified professional about your circumstances. We are not responsible for decisions or results based on this video.
